xyz.refinedev.practice.api.profile.history

Interface IProfileHistory

  • All Superinterfaces:
    java.lang.Comparable<IProfileHistory>

    public interface IProfileHistory
extends java.lang.Comparable<IProfileHistory>
    Represents a snapshot of a completed match for a player.

    Each IProfileHistory instance stores metadata about the match, including participants, outcome, timestamps, snapshots of inventories, and various statistics such as ELO changes, win streaks, kills, and deaths.

    Implementations of this interface should be comparable by their getDate() field to allow sorting histories chronologically.

    Since:
    9/25/2021
